verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a headless browser or desktop environment. It does document that each sandbox is a full Linux environment running in its own VM, with arbitrary shell execution, Docker-in-sandbox, and preview URLs/tunnels for exposed ports, so running something like headless Chromium is only inferable, not shown. Missing for 10: any documented headless browser support (e.g. Puppeteer/Playwright), any desktop/GUI environment (VNC, noVNC, X server), screenshot or remote-display APIs, and hands-on corroboration.
